Let's analyze the options:

Option A: "Be the change you want to see in the world" is the phrase most commonly attributed to Gandhi. It is widely quoted and associated with his philosophy, but there is no direct evidence that Gandhi ever said or wrote this exact phrase. It is more of a paraphrase or a summary of his ideas.

Option B: "If we could change ourselves, the tendencies in the world would also change" is much closer to something Gandhi actually wrote. In 1913, Gandhi wrote in "Indian Opinion": "If we could change ourselves, the tendencies in the world would also change. As a man changes his own nature, so does the attitude of the world change towards him. ...
